credit_reconciliations_period_unique.name: credit_reconciliations_period_unique
credit_reconciliations_period_unique.where: "credit_reconciliations"."period_start" is not null and "credit_reconciliations"."period_end" is not null

professional_links_verification_complete.name: professional_links_verification_complete
professional_links_verification_complete.value: ("professional_links"."verified_provider" is null and "professional_links"."verified_provider_user_id" is null and "professional_links"."verified_at" is null) or ("professional_links"."verified_provider" is not null and "professional_links"."verified_provider" in ('github', 'linkedin') and "professional_links"."verified_provider_user_id" is not null and btrim("professional_links"."verified_provider_user_id") <> '' and "professional_links"."verified_at" is not null)

profile_requests_pending_verification_ev.name: profile_requests_pending_verification_evidence
profile_requests_pending_verification_ev.value: "profile_requests"."status" <> 'pending' or ("profile_requests"."verification_method" is not null and btrim("profile_requests"."verification_method") <> '' and "profile_requests"."verification_evidence_reference" is not null and btrim("profile_requests"."verification_evidence_reference") <> '' and "profile_requests"."verified_at" is not null)

profiles_github_account_id_canonical.name: profiles_github_account_id_canonical
profiles_github_account_id_canonical.value: case when "profiles"."github_account_id" ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' then "profiles"."github_account_id"::numeric <= 9007199254740991 else false end or ("profiles"."searchable" = false and "profiles"."searchability_reason" = 'operator_suppression')

suppression_records_github_id_canonical.name: suppression_records_github_id_canonical
suppression_records_github_id_canonical.value: "suppression_records"."canonical_provider" <> 'github' or case when "suppression_records"."canonical_provider_id" ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' then "suppression_records"."canonical_provider_id"::numeric <= 9007199254740991 else false end
